cli.discovery: Read cliPath and versionCommand from the local Codex Praetor configuration; never commit a machine-specific path.

mappings.provider_semantics: Read, Grep and Glob only for a bounded local audit.
Read, Grep, Glob and Bash only for declared deterministic checks in a disposable worker worktree; source edits remain unavailable.
Edit and shell tools only inside the disposable worker worktree.

lifecycle.launch: invoke-codex-praetor.ps1 starts the bundled Node runner, which uses the Qoder Agent SDK with qodercliAuth() and a fixed tool/path contract.
lifecycle.parse_terminal_state: watch-codex-praetor-job.ps1 records process state, normalized failure class and evidence state; a Qoder cancellation is accepted only after the SDK runner records AbortController session termination.
lifecycle.cleanup: The watcher closes the job lifecycle; Qoder cancellation ends its SDK session and cold recovery starts a new session from Codex ledger state. Retained worktrees are reclaimed only by the controlled cleanup path.

evidence.end_to_end: A current-generation provider canary in an isolated worktree is required before real dispatch.
